description: STM32G030x6/x8 family (DS12991 Rev 3): Arm Cortex-M0+ 32-bit MCU up to 64MHz, 32KB Flash (F6 variant) with protection, 8KB SRAM with HW parity, 2x USART, 2x I2C (FM+), 2x SPI/1x I2S, 5-ch DMA, 12-bit ADC (14 ext + 2 int channels on this package), RTC+2 tamper pins, 8 timers, CRC unit. VDD 2.0-3.6V, TA -40 to 85C. TSSOP20, 17 GPIOs.

pinout.name: PB7/PB8
pinout.notes: Bonded pad (Fig.5/Table 12): PB7 alt=USART1_RX,SPI2_MOSI,TIM17_CH1N,I2C1_SDA,ADC_IN11; PB8 alt=SPI2_SCK,TIM16_CH1,I2C1_SCL. 5V-tolerant (FT_fa/FT_f). Reset-default: analog input.

pinout.name: PB9/PC14-OSC32_IN
pinout.notes: Bonded pad: PB9 alt=IR_OUT,TIM17_CH1,SPI2_NSS,I2C1_SDA; PC14-OSC32_IN = LSE 32.768kHz oscillator input. PC14 supplied through internal power switch (3mA sink limit): in output mode speed must not exceed 2MHz w/ max 30pF load, must not be used as a current source (Table 12 notes 1,2). FT.

pinout.name: PC15-OSC32_OUT
pinout.notes: LSE 32.768kHz oscillator output; alt=OSC32_EN/OSC_EN. Same power-switch 3mA sink limitation as PC14 (Table 12 notes 1,2). FT.

pinout.name: VDD/VDDA
pinout.notes: Single combined pin on TSSOP20 for VDD (digital+regulator), VDDA (ADC analog supply) and VDDIO1 (I/O supply), all electrically identical per Sec 3.7.1. Range 2.0-3.6V. VBAT and VREF+ have no dedicated pin on this package and are internally bonded to this pin (Sec 3.7.1/3.7.2).

pinout.name: VSS/VSSA
pinout.notes: Single combined digital + analog ground pin on TSSOP20.

pinout.name: NRST
pinout.notes: Active-low reset. I/O structure = RST (bidirectional, embedded weak pull-up). Permanent internal pull-up RPU = 25-55 kOhm (typ 40k), VIN=VSS test condition (Table 52). FT. Recommended external filter cap 0.1uF placed as close as possible to the device if an external reset network is added (Fig.19); device also has an internal POR/PDR.

pinout.name: PA0
pinout.notes: Alt: SPI2_SCK, USART2_CTS; ADC_IN0; additional TAMP_IN2, WKUP1. FT_a.

pinout.name: PA1
pinout.notes: Alt: SPI1_SCK/I2S1_CK, USART2_RTS_DE_CK, I2C1_SMBA, EVENTOUT; ADC_IN1. FT_ea.

pinout.name: PA2
pinout.notes: Alt: SPI1_MOSI/I2S1_SD, USART2_TX; ADC_IN2; additional WKUP4, LSCO. FT_a.

pinout.name: PA3
pinout.notes: Alt: SPI2_MISO, USART2_RX, EVENTOUT; ADC_IN3. FT_ea.

pinout.name: PA4
pinout.notes: Alt: SPI1_NSS/I2S1_WS, SPI2_MOSI, TIM14_CH1, EVENTOUT; additional ADC_IN4, TAMP_IN1, RTC_TS, RTC_OUT1, WKUP2 (TSSOP20/LQFP32 row of Table 12 - PC13's tamper/RTC functions are remapped here since PC13 is absent on this package). FT_a.

pinout.name: PA5
pinout.notes: Alt: SPI1_SCK/I2S1_CK, EVENTOUT; ADC_IN5. FT_ea.

pinout.name: PA6
pinout.notes: Alt: SPI1_MISO/I2S1_MCK, TIM3_CH1, TIM1_BK, TIM16_CH1; ADC_IN6. FT_ea.

pinout.name: PA7
pinout.notes: Alt: SPI1_MOSI/I2S1_SD, TIM3_CH2, TIM1_CH1N, TIM14_CH1, TIM17_CH1; ADC_IN7. FT_a.

pinout.name: PB0/PB1/PB2/PA8
pinout.notes: Bonded pad (4 pads, Fig.5): PB0 alt=SPI1_NSS/I2S1_WS,TIM3_CH3,TIM1_CH2N,ADC_IN8; PB1 alt=TIM14_CH1,TIM3_CH4,TIM1_CH3N,EVENTOUT,ADC_IN9; PB2 alt=SPI2_MISO,EVENTOUT,ADC_IN10; PA8 alt=MCO,SPI2_NSS,TIM1_CH1,EVENTOUT. FT_ea/FT.

pinout.name: PA11[PA9]
pinout.notes: Reset-default name PA11; bracket [PA9] = can be remapped in place of PA9 via SYSCFG_CFGR1 register (Table 12 note 4), default mapping is PA11. Alt: SPI1_MISO/I2S1_MCK, USART1_CTS, TIM1_CH4, TIM1_BK2, I2C2_SCL, EVENTOUT; ADC_IN15. FT_fa.

pinout.name: PA12[PA10]
pinout.notes: Reset-default name PA12; bracket [PA10] = can be remapped in place of PA10 via SYSCFG_CFGR1 register (Table 12 note 4), default mapping is PA12. Alt: SPI1_MOSI/I2S1_SD, USART1_RTS_DE_CK, TIM1_ETR, I2S_CKIN, I2C2_SDA; ADC_IN16. FT_fa.

pinout.name: PA13
pinout.notes: Reset default alt function = SWDIO (SW debug data I/O). Internal pull-up on this pin is active by default at reset for SW debug (Table 12 note 5). Also IR_OUT, EVENTOUT; ADC_IN17. FT_ea.

pinout.name: PA15/PA14-BOOT0
pinout.notes: IMPORTANT bonded pad: Table 12 lists BOTH 'PA14-BOOT0' and 'PA15' rows mapping to TSSOP20 pin 19, i.e. they share one physical bond pad (matches Fig.5 silkscreen label 'PA15/PA14-BOOT0'). PA14-BOOT0 side: reset-default alt=SWCLK (SW debug clock), also USART2_TX, EVENTOUT, ADC_IN18, and doubles as the BOOT0 boot-mode strap; internal pull-down active by default at reset (Table 12 note 5). PA15 side: alt=SPI1_NSS/I2S1_WS, USART2_RX, EVENTOUT. Because it is one physical node, SWD/BOOT0 use and PA15 GPIO/SPI/USART use are mutually exclusive on this package - see layout_notes.

pinout.name: PB3/PB4/PB5/PB6
pinout.notes: Bonded pad (4 pads, Fig.5): PB3 alt=SPI1_SCK/I2S1_CK,TIM1_CH2,USART1_RTS_DE_CK,EVENTOUT; PB4 alt=SPI1_MISO/I2S1_MCK,TIM3_CH1,USART1_CTS,TIM17_BK,EVENTOUT; PB5 alt=SPI1_MOSI/I2S1_SD,TIM3_CH2,TIM16_BK,I2C1_SMBA,WKUP6; PB6 alt=USART1_TX,TIM1_CH3,TIM16_CH1N,SPI2_MISO,I2C1_SCL,EVENTOUT. FT/FT_f.

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to, or below (underside of PCB), pin 4 (VDD/VDDA) / pin 5 (VSS/VSSA) pair
decoupling.notes: Fig.9 Power supply scheme + Sec 5.1.6 caution text: 'Power supply pin pair (VDD/VDDA and VSS/VSSA) must be decoupled with filtering ceramic capacitors as shown above ... placed as close as possible to, or below, the appropriate pins on the underside of the PCB.' Sec 'General PCB design guidelines' (pg70): the 100nF cap should be good-quality ceramic, placed as close as possible to the chip. Datasheet's Fig.9 also shows a separate 100nF between VREF+ and VREF-/VSSA, but VREF+ has no external pin on TSSOP20 (bonded internally to VDD/VDDA) so that discrete cap is not applicable to this package.

land_pattern.notes: From Fig.34 'TSSOP20 package footprint' (ref YA_FP_V1), the recommended LAND PATTERN (not the package outline): outer-to-outer pad span 7.10mm (row direction) x 6.25mm (pin1/20-to-pin10/11 direction); inner gap between the two pad rows 4.40mm (=> row pitch/center-to-center spacing 5.75mm); pad size 0.40mm x 1.35mm; 0.65mm pitch, 10 pads per row, 20 pads total. Pin 1 at bottom-left (pins 1-10 along the bottom edge left-to-right, pins 11-20 along the top edge left-to-right, pin 20 above pin 1). Package body outline (Table 69/Fig.33, for cross-check, NOT the land pattern): body 6.5mm(typ D) x 4.4mm(typ E1), 0.65mm lead pitch (e), lead width b=0.19-0.30mm, height A max 1.20mm, standoff A1=0.05-0.15mm.

layout_notes: VDD/VDDA (pin4) + VSS/VSSA (pin5) pair must be decoupled with ceramic caps placed as close as possible to, or directly below, the pins (Sec 5.1.6, Fig.9).
100nF decoupling cap must be good-quality ceramic, placed as close as possible to the chip (Sec 'General PCB design guidelines', pg70).

NRST (pin6): if adding an external reset network, place its filter capacitor (0.1uF typical) as close as possible to the device (Fig.19 note 3); the part already has an internal weak pull-up (25-55kOhm) and internal POR/PDR, so external RC is optional.

LSE 32.768kHz resonator on pins 2 (PC14-OSC32_IN) / 3 (PC15-OSC32_OUT): resonator and its load capacitors must be placed as close as possible to the oscillator pins to minimize output distortion and startup time (Sec 5.3.9 text, pg53). Exact CL/REXT values depend on the chosen crystal; ST's app note AN2867 'Oscillator design guide for ST microcontrollers' is referenced for details but is NOT available in this container (st.com unreachable) - see OPEN.

Pins 2/3 (PC14/PC15) are fed through an internal power switch limited to 3mA sink: if used as GPIO output, keep speed <=2MHz with <=30pF load and never use as a current source (e.g. do not drive an LED directly).

Pin 19 (PA15/PA14-BOOT0) is a single bonded pad carrying both PA14 (SWCLK debug clock + BOOT0 boot-strap) and PA15 (SPI1_NSS/USART2_RX) - they cannot be used independently. If SWD debug and/or BOOT0 strapping is needed, PA15's alternate functions are unavailable on this package, and vice versa.

PA13/pin18 (SWDIO) and the PA14 side of pin19 (SWCLK) have internal pull-up / pull-down respectively already active at reset for SW debug (Table 12 note 5) - no external pull resistors needed for a basic 2-wire SWD header.

VBAT and VREF+ have no dedicated external pin on TSSOP20; both are bonded internally to the VDD/VDDA pin (Sec 3.7.1) - do not expect or add separate VBAT/VREF+ decoupling networks on this package variant.
PB0/PB1/PB2/PA8 (pin15) and PB3/PB4/PB5/PB6 (pin20) are each 4-way bonded pads - only one of the bonded alternate functions can be used at a time per physical pin.
